criteria.minimum_sample: at least 30 closed trades, else the result is not significant

hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The majority of signals are long crypto positions in a risk‑on cross‑asset regime, but many of the lower‑tier symbols have zero volatility and risk metrics, indicating data gaps and fragile conviction. BTC, ETH and SOL show the strongest risk‑adjusted signals, while LTC is flat with a negative composite and should be de‑weighted. To preserve capital we stay neutral overall, applying a modest global risk multiplier below 1 and nudging the strongest bets slightly up while pulling back on the fragile, low‑information symbols.
